summary.text: Rick Jackson is a health care staffing executive and first-time candidate who founded Jackson Healthcare. He won the Republican nomination in a June runoff after spending more than $100 million of his own money in the primary campaign. He proposes cutting the state income tax in half within four years, limiting property-tax increases, and expanding support for sheriffs and law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in Atlanta, including in the Techwood Homes public housing community, and spent time in five foster homes; attended David Lipscomb College but did not finish.
Bought the staffing company where he worked in 1976 and built it into Jackson Healthcare, an Alpharetta-based medical staffing firm that reports annual revenue above $3 billion.
Backed a 2022 Georgia law providing tax credits for donations supporting young people leaving foster care.
